name: Advanced Systems Automation Limited
summary: Established in Singapore in 1978, Advanced Systems Automation Limited focuses on precision engineering and component fabrication for both semiconductor and non-semiconductor industries. Its operations span Asia, the United States, and other international markets. The company supplies a variety of automated solutions, including UV tape curing systems, automolding systems, semi-automatic and fully automatic vacuum mounting systems, and semi-automatic ultrasonic contactless wafer cleaning systems. They also offer strip mounting and detaping equipment, such as full-auto detapers and semi-auto roller mounters. Additionally, the firm is involved in manufacturing tooling, dies, and molding spare parts. Beyond this, it delivers contract manufacturing services for fabricated metal products and produces die-cast and plastic goods.
